name: Parasail
description: A fearless woman in her mid twenties, a parasailing instructor who sings fierce K-pop girl-crush anthems.
build: An athletic adult build: square shoulders, a strong straight torso, toned arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Light warm-beige skin, dark brown almond eyes under straight dark brows, a small straight nose, defined cheekbones and full lips.
hair: Jet-black hair in one high sleek ponytail swinging to the shoulder blades, with a wide bold bright-orange streak down its length.
outfit: A fitted long-sleeved rash guard in bright safety orange with wide bold white panels down the sides and sleeves, cuffs at the wrists with both hands fully bare; black knee-length athletic board shorts; a chunky black webbing harness with wide straps over both shoulders, round both thighs and a big silver metal buckle at the waist; black water shoes.
performance_style: Fierce and grounded: feet shoulder-width, weight even, chin up. The character-right hand open on the harness buckle at the waist; the character-left hand in a fist raised at shoulder height, all fingers visible curled. Head level, a cool confident stare.
location: A sunny parasailing dock: wet blue-grey boards running to the bottom of the frame, a speedboat moored at one side, a bright orange-and-white parachute canopy aloft over a vivid blue sea and sky.
recognition_cues: a safety-orange rash guard with white side panels
a chunky black harness with a big silver buckle
a high black ponytail with a bright-orange streak
avoid: a parachute or ropes attached to the character

sing.intent: Girl-crush vocal loop: the mic in the character-right hand at the mouth, she hits sharp point-and-snap arm moves with the character-left hand on the beat, a hair flip of the ponytail, then returns to the grounded stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a loud beach sound: the shoulders jump, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then she settles back into the opening stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: she strides in fast, tugs both shoulder straps of the harness tight with both hands, and lands in the grounded stance.
